scope.title: Common Ground: the ch13 return to Origin and the reciprocal survey proof, entered at the actual restored Tidegarden core under the prior station-continuation contract.
nonGoals: No publication, redeployment or change to the ch4-arrival public release ceiling.
No new light source, postprocessing effect, overlay, reticle or grade change.
No camera takeover, forced look, view switch or field-of-view change; the player keeps the 75 degree embodied view throughout.
No worldgen edit, prepared-anchor regeneration or terrain restoration during ordinary entry.
No audio engine change, new graph, hit bundle, route ranking, guaranteed attack or listening gate.
No new plot exploration, canon, A5 warp or Light, A6 alliance, later Lens or Frame, identity reveal, station surveillance, new cell fault, fauna consequence or marker puzzle.
No new attributed Worker 9 voice, act or motif.
No gaze, reticle, screen visibility, camera quaternion, music phase or optional foliage input to any reference predicate.
No coda, deferred, hydrated or replayed final texture beyond the live-only bound.
No mass copy cleanup; shipped ch1 to ch12 copy and receipts are unchanged.
No re-registration of station:return:tidegarden or hearth:return:install-cell as ch13 guidance or as a ch13 beat; both stay shipped UX baseline and prior-contract continuity evidence.

No synthetic restored-hearth StoryBeat is invented for the ch12 installation: the live hearth acknowledgement belongs to ch13-home, and the install transaction is never delayed or replayed to produce one.

story.purpose: Terra returns to Origin by choice and learns to tell traversability from demonstrability: she must depend on a reference another body maintains, and then maintain one for him.
story.emotionalBefore: Having crossed feels like having finished the proof; the home is repaired and the old fault is a loose end she owns.
story.emotionalAfter: She accepts another body's necessary contribution to a result she wants, while their accounts remain different and his record stays incomplete.
story.intendedAmbiguity: His interiority, larger allegiance and later awakening remain unknown. Local usefulness is not friendship, and no cosmology is disclosed.
nonNegotiableCanon: W-7744 retains LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE. and gains no interior monologue.
Worker 9 and the third consciousness gain no new attributed voice, act or motif.
The A5 Light, the later offworld and A5 return question, and all later reveals stay protected and unmentioned.

Existing shipped chapter copy and receipt identities remain unchanged. New ch13 copy follows the signed council-v2 candidate and its register, including the two added Terra comparison lines; this is not a limit of two new lines in the entire chapter.
Sensory or involuntary thought is lowercase parenthetical, deliberate intent is bare lowercase, and W-7744 stays procedural capitals.

The public demo release surface remains ch4-arrival and no publication or redeployment is authorized here; separately, the formal runtime chapter ceiling is authorized to advance to ch13-common once these four beats are registered under this signed contract and the registry gate, so the release boundary and the runtime ceiling are distinct and must not be conflated.
The reality stage ceiling is alive on all four beats, resume, diagnostic entry and completed visits.

events.event: Terra offers to demonstrate a route; the survey opens actor-scoped and world-scoped.
events.playerAction: Press F to offer to demonstrate a route.
events.informationRevealed: He will accept a demonstration but not an assertion.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The explicit F beside the actor opens an actor/world-scoped awaiting-start state and publishes ch13:survey:start at S. No sample is recorded beside him. Only the subsequent actual grounded F at S begins the initial trace and replaces start guidance with quiet draw guidance toward E.

events.event: Actual grounded F at the survey start S begins the quiet trace and records the first sample; nothing was recorded beside the inspecting actor.
events.playerAction: Walk to the survey start S and press F to begin recording your route.
events.informationRevealed: Recording begins where she chooses to begin walking, not where she stands to speak.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The one-time ch13:survey:start marker targets S only, never E and never the inspection actor; no sample exists before this actual grounded F; the start objective is then replaced by the single quiet draw objective targeting E.

events.event: Continuous grounded walking forms a finite valid trace to the survey end; growth is quiet.
events.playerAction: Walk the route to the survey end.
events.informationRevealed: A walked line is a proposal, not a proof.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Trace growth is visible without any per-sample chime, prompt or microstep, honours the sample and length caps without decimation, and stops honestly at capacity. The same readiness applies to an initial route or a changed unverified suffix; reaching drawing readiness does not itself offer the span or grant tested proof.

events.event: Terra offers the walked span for W-7744 to test; the proposal becomes physical, not proof.
events.playerAction: Press F to offer the walked span.
events.informationRevealed: Only an offered span can be tested.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The explicit F requires a valid finite walked proposal. W-7744 physically approaches S from his actual inspection pose W under dry-ground, solid and body-clearance checks. The approach earns no tested-prefix or reciprocal proof and vacates W before optional witness use. Actual survey testing begins only after he reaches S; until then guidance reports preparation/readiness truthfully.

events.event: The player selects the available unverified-tail revision at its actual last tested point; the unchanged return/F work order is presented before any edit.
events.playerAction: Return voluntarily to the actual last tested point of an offered unverified span and inspect its F revision prompt, or keep the existing proposal.
events.informationRevealed: A proposal remains revisable without first manufacturing a failure.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Publish revision readiness only when an offered unverified suffix exists and the player chooses or returns to its actual revision point; the point is S if no sample has been tested. No refusal is required, no F has committed yet, and this readiness event changes neither route data nor proof. The same readiness may be entered after a real hold. A valid current route may remain unchanged.

events.event: Contingent: an actually offered span reaches its first unsupported reference or footing relation, so W-7744 holds at the last safe sample and reports the literal cause.
events.playerAction: Choose the appropriate repair: revise unsafe ground or an unverified tail, or offer a valid occupied reference where reference loss permits it.
events.informationRevealed: The instrument has a finite useful range and a real blind side.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Emit only for an actual unsupported offered span, distinguishing REFERENCE OCCLUDED · SURVEY HOUSING, REFERENCE OUT OF RANGE, other solid occlusion and unsafe footing. The measured short route supplies one housing-shadow example; any supported route, including the measured long route, may complete without this anchor. Do not force failure. Temporary vacancy or body-clearance suspension of an established witness uses its resumable state without restarting refusal. Unsafe footing cannot be repaired by occupying a witness.

events.event: Contingent: the player stands at the intermediate reference, explicitly offers that end, and the test proceeds.
events.playerAction: Stand at the marked reference and press F to offer that end.
events.informationRevealed: A held reference is a physical contribution, not a courtesy.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Validity uses same-world identity, grounding, explicit offer, socket-to-socket range, occupancy hysteresis, body clearance and a clear solid segment; camera direction is never an input.

events.event: Contingent: the holder leaves the release cylinder, so the test holds at the last safe sample and keeps the proof.
events.playerAction: Leave the release cylinder; looking around is free and changes nothing.
events.informationRevealed: Withheld: no blame, no failure text; the test simply cannot continue unreferenced.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Leaving the release cylinder holds before the next unsupported sample, retains earned proof, keeps the offer resumable, and publishes the resume objective rather than a failure.

events.event: Contingent: reentry to the inner cylinder revalidates geometry and resumes the test without a second F.
events.playerAction: Walk back into the inner cylinder.
events.informationRevealed: Nothing was lost by stepping away.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Resumption requires live revalidation of range, sight, occupancy and clearance and consumes no new input; the musical texture does not restart.

events.event: Contingent: the player explicitly presses F at the actual last tested point to reopen only the unverified tail; a refusal alone never edits the proposal.
events.playerAction: Press F at the last tested point to reopen the untested span.
events.informationRevealed: The exact reason the span failed, in literal terms.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Commit only on the actual valid F at the last tested point. Preserve the tested prefix unless real terrain edits invalidate it; retain the literal current reason, including the exact REFERENCE OCCLUDED · SURVEY HOUSING middle-dot text. A hold, pause, failed input or Continue never reopens or resets a tail.

events.event: Contingent: the unverified suffix is replaced at no cost; the tested prefix survives.
events.playerAction: Walk a new route for the reopened tail.
events.informationRevealed: Revision is free and the tested part still counts.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Revision is unlimited and free, replaces only the unverified suffix, preserves the tested prefix, and cannot cut across the demonstrated argument.

events.event: W-7744 completes his grounded test of the offered span; the chosen survey class is saved.
events.playerAction: Follow his progress, or revise from the last tested point.
events.informationRevealed: Two different complete routes are equally real.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Both route classes are complete equal outcomes with no ranking; first-try success is legal; the survey class is saved separately from the reciprocal comparison.

events.event: W-7744 physically walks the uncredited two-unit E to H leg and actually reaches and maintains the held reference at H (-40, 51.05, 12) before Terra starts her comparison.

events.informationRevealed: The reference has to be somebody standing somewhere before it can support anything.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The reciprocal work order publishes its holding claim only after his actual arrival at H; before that it reports preparation or readiness; the positioning leg earns no comparison or test credit and changes no score state.

events.event: W-7744 actually maintains the reference at distinct H=(-40,51.05,12) while Terra completes the full 18-unit E-to-C common passage for her own comparison.
events.playerAction: Walk the traced common span while he holds the reference.
events.informationRevealed: She could not have finished this alone while walking.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Record only Terra's actual complete E-to-C passage, maintained from the physical worker at H throughout under the same range, solid-sight, grounding and clearance rules. His E-to-H positioning earns no proof. Neither the six-unit endpoint separation, old footsteps, a virtual socket, saved proof, camera orientation nor elapsed time substitutes for this passage.

events.event: Terra explicitly offers the separate far reference, clear of the tested span; conditions for his choice, not a command.

events.informationRevealed: She can supply the same kind of contribution she needed.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The explicit valid F offer replaces the guidance and does not commit his test; his initiation remains his.

events.event: Contingent: Terra leaves the release cylinder during his test, so it holds at the last safe sample.
events.playerAction: Leave the release cylinder; looking away is free.
events.informationRevealed: Withheld: no reproach; the physical condition simply lapses.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The hold retains the proof and offer, publishes the reference-return objective, and does not restart a mood or refuse dramatically.

events.event: Contingent: reentry and live revalidation resume his test without another F.
events.playerAction: Walk back to the far reference, clear of the tested span.
events.informationRevealed: Conditions, not sentiment, carry the test.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Neither saved evidence nor elapsed time exempts the resumed test from live range, sight, occupancy and clearance.

events.event: CG-06: after the actual uncredited two-unit H to E return and a valid far Terra reference at T (-44, 51.05, 12), W-7744 begins his independent full 18-unit E to C test.

events.event: CG-07: W-7744 actually arrives at the far end of his independent full E to C test and the reciprocal proof commits exactly once.

events.informationRevealed: LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE. His actual final arrival with the reciprocal proof earns this annotation; his account remains different from hers.

performance.measurementPlan: Budget semantics are DELTAS over the locked shipped source and runtime, not absolute scene counts and not measurements. The accepted Cinematography budget is at most +8 draw calls, +6 materials, +6 shader programs added during setup and +2 MiB (2097152 bytes) of added GPU storage, with at most 512 pooled trace glyph instances across exactly two route slots of at most 128 points each. Inside the +/-2 second critical window around every critical verb anchor and the handback, zero new shader programs are compiled and zero new resources are first used; setup work is prewarmed outside that window, light cardinality is fixed at zero new lights and zero new cardinality transitions, and there are no frame-loop allocations. The 60 fps target, 30 fps minimum and 33.4 ms frame time are advisory triage ceilings carried forward from the shipped runtime; the binding hardware requirement is cold high-tier and lowest-tier handback plus frames-per-second non-regression against the source-pinned baseline, with the existing critical-window hitch and resource gates retained. Draw, program and storage deltas and the frame-time distribution are recorded at setup, at each critical anchor, at handback and on a repeated visit, and bounded counters must hold without monotonic growth. No measured frame or resource budget pass is claimed by this contract: scene-cinema-lane.json records measuredFrameBudgetPass false and measuredResourceBudgetPass false.
